headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 16-2 victory. Carson Kelly led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 6 RBIs. In other action, the Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 4-3 in a close game, with Matt Vierling leading the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs. The New York Yankees shut out the Cincinnati Reds 5-0, with Ben Rice leading the Reds' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Michael Helman being transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture. Ryne Nelson has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 16, 2026, with a strained right elbow. Wenceel Pérez has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 17, 2026, with a left orbital fracture. Mike Trout has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Everson Pereira has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Cole Ragans has been placed on the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement. Spencer Strider has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Chase DeLauter has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 14, 2026, with a right side rib fracture.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including Hunter Stratton being traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded catcher Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Kansas City Royals traded right-hander Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for right-hander Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Yankees in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Cincinnati Reds 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Ben Rice led the Reds' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Tampa**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 2-5 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays, with the Rays' Griffin Jax earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, 0 BB, 4 H. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 1 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI in 4 AB.

top_news.title: **Helman Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture.

top_news.title: **Stratton Heads to Pittsburgh in Trade**
top_news.summary: Hunter Stratton has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates, joining the team after being dealt from the Atlanta Braves. The trade also sent catcher Joey Bart to the Braves.
